widget.name: Pushwoosh events
widget.description: Initializes Pushwoosh and triggers nanoflows when a push notification arrives or is opened. Place it once, on the home page.

property.caption: Application Code
property.description: The Pushwoosh Application Code, for example XXXXX-XXXXX. Found in the Pushwoosh Control Panel.

property.caption: Register on load
property.description: Register the device for push notifications as soon as this widget loads. On iOS this shows the system permission prompt, so turn it off if you would rather ask later with the Register action.

property.caption: On initialized
property.description: Triggered once the Pushwoosh SDK has started.

property.caption: On registered
property.description: Triggered when the device has a push token. The token is written to the Push token attribute first.

property.caption: Push token
property.description: The attribute the push token is written to before On registered runs.

property.caption: Payload
property.description: The attribute the full push payload is written to, as JSON, before the event action runs.

property.caption: Message
property.description: The attribute the notification text is written to before the event action runs.

property.caption: On push received
property.description: Triggered when a push notification arrives while the app is in the foreground.

property.caption: On push opened
property.description: Triggered when the user taps a push notification.

property.caption: Deep link
property.description: The attribute the deep link URL from the push is written to before On deep link runs.

property.caption: On deep link
property.description: Triggered when an opened push carries a deep link. Runs in addition to On push opened.
